begin_of_turn_query.content: 想像一下，我剛開始了一次愉快的公路旅行，並且需要在加油站停下來。你能幫我加滿15公升的汽油嗎？請以加侖的第二位小數精度來加油。完成後，如果你能檢查一下輪胎壓力，那就太好了——我想和我的Twitter追隨者分享我出色的汽車維護技巧，附上訊息「剛加滿油箱並檢查了輪胎壓力。準備好迎接下一次冒險！」。如果你還能啟動引擎並告訴我電池電壓和油量，那將非常有幫助。

messages.content: 想像一下，我剛開始了一次愉快的公路旅行，並且需要在加油站停下來。你能幫我加滿15公升的汽油嗎？請以加侖的第二位小數精度來加油。完成後，如果你能檢查一下輪胎壓力，那就太好了——我想和我的Twitter追隨者分享我出色的汽車維護技巧，附上訊息「剛加滿油箱並檢查了輪胎壓力。準備好迎接下一次冒險！」。如果你還能啟動引擎並告訴我電池電壓和油量，那將非常有幫助。

Then post tweet with content and tags? They want to mention? They didn't specify tags or mentions. Just content. So we call fillFuelTank with fuelAmount converted. Then get tire pressure. Then post tweet with content. Then get battery voltage? There's no function to get battery voltage directly. But we have get_user_stats? No. For vehicle, we have displayCarStatus with option "battery" maybe returns battery voltage. Also get_current_speed? Not needed. So after filling, we call check_tire_pressure. Then post tweet. Then displayCarStatus with option "battery". Also maybe displayCarStatus with option "fuel" to get fuel level. But they asked battery voltage and oil quantity. Oil quantity not available. Maybe displayCarStatus with "fuel" gives fuel level. So we do displayCarStatus twice? Or combine? We'll do displayCarStatus for battery and fuel. Then we might also get outside temperature? Not needed.

We need to convert 15 liters to gallons. Use liter_to_gallon. Then feed result to fillFuelTank. Then check tire pressure. Then post tweet. Then displayCarStatus for battery and fuel. Let's do it stepwise.
